Shared-memory cache creation, join, leave, delete, and access helpers for fragment metadata and app data.

# Purpose
This file implements the public lifecycle and access functions for an `fd_mcache` shared-memory cache. It provides [`fd_mcache_align`](<#fd_mcache_align>) and [`fd_mcache_footprint`](<#fd_mcache_footprint>) to define the required alignment and total memory size for a cache instance, with checks for invalid `depth` and `app_sz` values and for arithmetic overflow. It also defines [`fd_mcache_new`](<#fd_mcache_new>), [`fd_mcache_join`](<#fd_mcache_join>), [`fd_mcache_leave`](<#fd_mcache_leave>), and [`fd_mcache_delete`](<#fd_mcache_delete>) to create, attach to, detach from, and destroy the cache in shared memory. These functions validate the shared-memory address, clear and initialize the header, set the cache metadata, and use memory fences when publishing or clearing the `magic` field.

The file also exposes accessors for the cache state and layout. Functions such as [`fd_mcache_depth`](<#fd_mcache_depth>), [`fd_mcache_app_sz`](<#fd_mcache_app_sz>), and [`fd_mcache_seq0`](<#fd_mcache_seq0>) return values stored in the private header. Functions [`fd_mcache_seq_laddr_const`](<#fd_mcache_seq_laddr_const>), [`fd_mcache_seq_laddr`](<#fd_mcache_seq_laddr>), [`fd_mcache_app_laddr_const`](<#fd_mcache_app_laddr_const>), and [`fd_mcache_app_laddr`](<#fd_mcache_app_laddr>) return local addresses for the sequence array and the application data area. The code uses private header helpers from `fd_mcache_private.h` to map between the public cache pointer and the internal shared-memory layout.
